description: This file contains the implementation of the StaticGatewayListProvider class, which provides a static list of gateways for Orleans messaging, configured via options.

classes.name: StaticGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to supply a static list of gateways with configurable staleness and updatability.

methods.name: StaticGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with options and gateway options.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the gateway list provider; here it completes immediately.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Returns the list of gateways as a task.
